findings: Both actual30-step runs preserve float source samples into the actual VAE encoder and produce finite unclamped native1024 predictions within the model domain. Both strict canonical RAW inverses accept the actual decoder candidates.

Three actual RAW bakes pass54 full-frame f32 known-sample preservation cases and54 independently read native PNG known/protected grade comparisons. Original RAW bytes unchanged. This is preservation evidence for these experiments, not broad color or runtime parity.
Radius8 removes visible target face, coat and bag but native Auto output retains a target-shaped outline, edge/color remnants and mismatched reconstructed detail. Photograph remains unqualified.
Radius192 produces a dark figure-like shape and a severe cutout boundary when applied through the same accepted coverage. Larger generation is not an acceptable repair here.

Native Poisson correction converges, remains in range and preserves known source, but visible target-shaped boundary/texture/color remnants remain. Numeric preservation does not establish removal quality.

SAM masks changed with current-main proxy. No independent ownership/closure truth isolates which remnants come from incomplete selection versus reconstruction/boundary mismatch. No automated semantic-quality acceptance is claimed.

PowerPaint_float_tests.scope: Actual digest-verified upstream preprocessing retains sub-u8 differences; binary mask polarity; malformed/mismatched/nonfinite/range float input; incomplete boundary/steps refusal; unclamped out-of-range decoder/candidate evidence. Exact byte-size guard also rejects incomplete trailing float payload bytes. Legacy u8/PIL conditioning retains exact native proxy samples.
